services.name: Steer Me Right
services.bestFor: Buyers whose car is within 200 miles
features: One model, with any trims, colors and packages within that model
Dealers within 200 miles of the buyer’s ZIP code
New, used and certified pre-owned dealer inventory
Price negotiation and fee review
One dedicated advisor, start to finish
Written recommendations: what we found and what we would do
Expected start time confirmed after payment and intake verification

services.name: Steer Me Right Pro
services.bestFor: Buyers who want the best deal anywhere in the country
features: Everything in Steer Me Right
Dealers nationwide, not just within 200 miles
Shipping quotes on long-distance deals; the buyer pays the carrier
Trade-in support: we compare offers on the trade-in from several areas and negotiate it with the deal
Offers on up to three models priced side by side (a model is a make and model; trims, colors and packages within a model do not count extra)
Our pick of the best deal, judged on out-the-door price plus resale and running costs, not just the sticker

services.name: Steer Me Right Private Client
services.bestFor: Buyers of cars with an MSRP of $100,000 or more
features: Everything in Steer Me Right Pro, for as many models as the buyer likes
Allocation and build-slot search, and factory orders, when the car is not on a lot
Negotiation of market adjustments and dealer-installed add-ons
An independent inspection arranged on a used car; the buyer pays the shop
Lease and loan check: money factor, residual and rate markup
The buyer’s order and finance-office products reviewed before signing
Enclosed transport quotes and a delivery-day checklist
Same-day replies from Mason on business days
services.capacity: Four Private Client searches at a time; a buyer who pays when all four are taken is told within one business day and may wait or take a full refund
